Grubhub.fix: Use vx10 with ten-second wait, request HTML and Markdown, parse review cards and star icons, verify name/address/ZIP, retain reviews if summarization fails.

Yelp.rootCause: Business HTML could return HTTP 200 while the separate review feed remained Loading. Rendered requests were intermittent, including provider HTTP 555 execution timeout at 153 seconds. Generic page extraction did not capture the structured review feed.
Yelp.fix: Match name/street/ZIP and business ID in native HTML; retrieve the public GetBusinessReviewFeed query through Nimble vx6 XHR without visitor cookies or ID. Fall back to vx10-pro browser network capture and wait for written review elements. Preserve structured reviews independently of summary provider.
